artworks.title: Death with a Coffin
artworks.description: The image displays bold, angular lines and sharp curves forming an intricate pattern resembling a skeletal figure. The lines create a visual impression akin to a ribcage and skull, reminiscent of a human skeleton carrying an object resembling a coffin. The stark contrast between dark and light areas emphasizes the abstract nature of the artwork.

artworks.title: Achilles as Pyrrha with Cupid
artworks.artist: Jan Thomas after Sir Anthony Van Dyck
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of two figures. One is an adult female and the other a cherubic child. The woman is seated, facing left, looking back at the viewer. She has curled hair, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose. She wears a draped, long-sleeved garment and holds a helmet in her right hand. The cherub stands beside her with wings, curly hair, and similar facial features. The cherub wears a sash and has a quiver of arrows on their back. The background is dark with a small piece of text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Sheet of Sketches
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse, leaping over a fence with dogs and buildings in the background. The horse is in mid-leap, with the rider maintaining a steady posture. Two buildings with distinct architectural elements are shown in the background, suggesting an outdoor setting near a residential area. Two dogs are also depicted in the scene, reacting to the movement of the horse. The drawing is done in a loose and expressive style, emphasizing motion over details.

artworks.title: January
artworks.description: The image shows a winter landscape with trees and a village in the distance. The detailed etching features leafless trees, buildings, ice, and people engaged in various activities. The monochrome color palette highlights contrast and shading, typical of traditional etchings.

artworks.title: February
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the middle, featuring a coastal town with towers and buildings. The artwork is detailed with fine linework depicting the water, clouds, and the boat sailing to the right. The scene is depicted in black and white, with trees on the sides.

artworks.title: March
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a low horizon, clusters of buildings, a distant tree line, a dirt road, leafless trees, birds in the sky, people in period clothing engaging in various activities, and a monochromatic color palette. The intricate details, including clouds and branches, draw the viewer's attention from the foreground to the background.

artworks.title: April
artworks.description: The image displays a classical engraving of a rural landscape. A church steeple is on the left with a line of trees and the church on the horizon blending into the sky filled with clouds. The intricate line work creates textures and depth in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. A path, a horse, and figures are depicted in the foreground, with buildings, livestock, and birds in the distance.

artworks.title: May
artworks.description: The image is a wide landscape scene captured in a black and white, drawn style. The horizon line is placed high with the tops of trees and rooflines of various buildings. The group of structures is separated from the sky above which is dotted with clouds. Closest to us, a group of people is seen conversing along a path by a water body, where a man is seen handling a small boat. Beyond them are trees, buildings, and what appears to be a church or grand house with a spire at the center. The image is highly detailed, with lines and cross-hatching creating texture and depth in grays and browns rendered in ink. The left side is dominated by a large tree extending its branches overhead.

artworks.title: June
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with an elevated perspective. A bridge spans the horizon, windmills dot the landscape, and there are various elements like trees, buildings, and figures depicted with detailed etching. The color palette is sepia and brown, highlighting the linework. In the forefront, figures are engaged in agricultural activities with animals nearby, while structures, trees, and a bridge lead to the expansive landscape. The sky has well-defined clouds and flocks of birds, adding to the rural charm of the scene.

artworks.title: July
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon shows rolling hills, a distant town with a church spire, and a group of resting workers with farming tools. A detailed tree is on the left. The color palette is monochromatic with varying sepia shades. A river cuts through the landscape leading to fields, a sky with clouds, and a flock of birds. The background detail is rendered with thin lines.

artworks.title: August
artworks.description: The image is a black and white print depicting a pastoral scene from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon divides the land and sky. In the center, there are buildings, including a church with Gothic windows and a tower. Several figures are engaged in various activities. The landscape has fields and trees. The sky is filled with swirling clouds and the overall color palette is monochromatic. The fine linework adds detail and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: September
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a river or canal viewed from above. There is a stone bridge in the center, dividing the landscape, depicted in detailed engraving style with a monochromatic color scheme. People are seen near the water engaging in various activities, with houses, trees, and a bridge in the background. The sky above features clouds and birds.

artworks.title: October
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a riverbank in the foreground. In the center, there are three people working and tools scattered around them. To the right, there are horses attached to a cart near a rocky outcrop with a castle on it. The castle has a tall tower and several peaked roofs surrounded by trees. The terrain slopes down towards the river on the left, leading to distant hills with scattered structures and boats along the water. The horizon is in the middle of the image, balancing the composition. The sky has swirling clouds in fine, intricate lines. The entire scene is depicted in detailed lines with a monochromatic palette, characteristic of etching techniques from its era.

artworks.title: November
artworks.description: The image shows a rural area with figures engaged in various activities. On the left, people work around a barn-like structure with a thatched roof. There are houses along a path with a riverbank on the right. In the distance, there is a church tower. The sky occupies a large part of the image with clouds and birds. The artwork is an etching with detailed linework and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: December
artworks.description: The image depicts a wintry village scene. The vantage point is slightly elevated, showing a busy town square and canal. The horizon is lined with rooftops, chimneys, and bare trees. Smoke rises from the chimneys. People are shown engaging in various activities in the foreground, with detailed brushstrokes. A bridge spans the canal, surrounded by more buildings and trees. The background shows more architecture and a cloudy sky. The color scheme is muted, dominated by browns, beige, and grayscale. The scene is lively and balanced, with structured lines.

artworks.title: Fountain with Statue of Neptune
artworks.description: The image shows a fountain sculpture with a central figure of a male deity holding a trident. The deity is seated on a woven structure with three putti pouring water into a basin below. The basin is decorated with reliefs of human figures, animals, and acanthus leaves. Two putti above dolphins are below the basin. The sculpture rests on a base with wave patterns.

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.artist: Jakob Christoffel Le Blon after Nicholas Blakey
artworks.medium: color mezzotint and etching printed in black, yellow, blue, carmine, brown, and white inks
artworks.description: The image shows a man with curly white hair wearing a blue coat with a star-shaped emblem. He is positioned facing slightly to the left, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has strong eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a subtle lipline. Underneath his coat, he wears a white ruffled shirt. The background is dark and indistinct.

artworks.title: Brunnhilde
artworks.description: The image displays a profile view of a person from the head to just below the shoulders, seated or resting. The individual has long, wavy hair flowing past their shoulders. Their facial features are softly outlined, with a composed expression, looking forward. They wear a simple garment, and the background includes faint vertical lines and light shading, with two small flowers sketched.

artworks.title: Parsifal
artworks.description: This is a close-up, monochromatic drawing of a person shown from the chest upwards. The person is in a static position, facing forward. The facial features are softly defined with dark eyes, a straight nose, and unsmiling lips. Their hair is covered by a textured helmet or cap that covers the head entirely, fitting closely and extending down towards the neck. The person is wearing a cloak with evident folds and a high, possibly ribbed collar visible beneath. Their right hand is holding a long spear and is at the edge of the image. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Perversite (Perversity)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the shoulders up, with their head turned slightly to the side. The person's face is positioned in profile, with distinct facial features including a refined nose and subtle chin. The person has short, textured hair styled close to the scalp. They appear to be wearing draped fabric, with the surrounding background mainly dark to create a contrast. The composition emphasizes light and shadow, giving it a dramatic and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Head of Cabbage with Insects
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 18.6 x 28.5 cm (7 5/16 x 11 1/4 in.)
support: 19.4 x 29.2 cm (7 5/8 x 11 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a large head of a cabbage at its center, with butterflies and various insects surrounding it. The cabbage is shades of green with variations in color creating depth and texture to the leaves. The butterflies have vibrant colors including orange, black, and white, contrasting with the cabbage. Various insects are placed around the cabbage: a butterfly on the left, another near the center, a ladybug near the top right, and other insects towards the right and lower parts. The background is a neutral beige color.

artworks.title: Four Scenes from the Legends of Judas and Pilate
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash,  heightened with white and gold, on gray prepared paper (grisaille)
artworks.dimensions: overall (rounded top edge): 15.9 x 18.2 cm (6 1/4 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of four medieval scenes. The image portrays four distinct panels illustrating different narratives set against a stylized medieval architectural background. The upper left panel depicts two women kneeling in front of an altar while a third woman stands behind them. The upper right panel shows a violent scene with one figure standing over another ready to strike with a weapon. The lower left panel features a dramatic moment of distress with one figure standing near another figure lying on the ground. The lower right panel illustrates a bedroom scene with one figure standing at the bedside confronting a person in bed, with a dog on the floor. This artwork is in the style of a medieval or early Renaissance artist, showcasing detailed social interactions within a historical context.

artworks.title: Four Scenes from the Life of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash,  heightened with white and gold, on gray prepared paper (grisaille)
artworks.dimensions: overall (rounded top edge): 15.9 x 18.3 cm (6 1/4 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a series of religious scenes divided into four quadrants. In the upper left quadrant, a figure is mounted on a donkey surrounded by a crowd. The upper right quadrant shows an interior with figures gathered around engaged in an act of teaching or discussion, highlighted by architectural elements. The lower left quadrant portrays figures in a formal posture, possibly in a procession or ceremonial context. The lower right quadrant reveals an interior setting where a group is interacting around a central figure. The scenes are detailed with an emphasis on architectural and figural elements, in shades of grey with gold highlights. The style is reminiscent of religious iconography from early Renaissance or late Gothic periods.
